# Discord Bots Post Stats

Before you start to post the stats on [Discord Bots](https://discord.bots.gg/), first you need to pick up the token. [Regenerate your new API token here](https://discord.bots.gg/docs)

---

Done regenerate your new API token, now do this on your main file.
```js
const discordbots = require('discordbotsgg')
const dbots = new discordbots('1 8  I D  b o t', 'Y O U R  A P I  T O K E N')
```

---

### postStats
Post the stats on Discord Bots Client.

```js
dbots.postStats(bot.guilds.size, bot.shard.count, bot.shard.id)
```
| Name       | Type     | Default | Description                                    |
|------------|----------|---------|------------------------------------------------|
| guildCount | integer  |    -    | The number of guilds.                          |
| shardCount | integer? | 1       | The number of shards the bot is running.       |
| shardId    | integer? | 0       | The shardId that is reporting the guild count. |

#### Response
```json
{
  "guildCount": 10,
  "shardCount": 1
}
```
